decision_scope: Draft specification is feasible for C1 evidence validation and read-only inventory; this is not implementation acceptance, OS isolation verification or permission for live execution.

assessment.schema: Task and verification documents validate against existing schemas; allowed and forbidden paths do not overlap. Draft null baseline is valid; frozen publication must bind the exact baseline and external manifest.
assessment.feasibility: Standalone boundary module requires only standard-library validation, datetime parsing and deepcopy. Existing ProcessRunner is not changed and its process management does not establish OS isolation. No M2B API or merge is necessary.
assessment.security_meaning: Declared/observed/enforced are submission consistency fields only. All-unknown unexecuted records remain valid; require_live_execution always rejects, including allow_live arguments. Source references are not opened or attested.
assessment.scope: Four implementation delivery paths and 1800 diff lines are sufficient. Inventory is read-only and excludes new resources, credentials, model probes and hostile host tests. Missing Mac prerequisites must remain not_run/unknown.
assessment.budget: Cycle time and agent-start numbers are advisory under current user instructions. Per-command 120 seconds/64KiB, scope, permissions, freshness and truthful evidence remain binding. Historical consumption is not reset.
